messages:
Taylor R: FYI opened a small hotfix PR to docs to add status page link + 'known issue' note for the 13:42 outage. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2441. Need a docs review + approval to merge quickly.
Nadia V: Pinged. Do we also need a short workaround for tokens expiring? Ops asked for a minimal safe snippet they can paste.
Taylor R: Added this non-sensitive snippet under the workaround section: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tokens/refresh -H 'Authorization: Bearer <masked>'` and a note to rotate tokens after restore. Kept wording minimal to avoid exposing internal steps.
Infra CI: link-checker failed on `/status#service-2026-03-21` anchor (404 fragment) 
Taylor R: Netlify preview shows the fragment on the status page, but our validator flags it until the Ops entry is created.
Nadia V: Ops has to add the incident entry + anchor. Can we point to `/status#recent-incidents` as a stable intermediate anchor? That keeps links valid for customers.
Taylor R: I can switch the PR to `/status#recent-incidents` and add a short inline note: "Specific incident anchor will be added to status page; see incident INC-462."
Docs Bot: deploy-preview 2441 created — https://deploy-preview-2441--redwood-docs.netlify.app/known-issues — build passed content lint, link-check pending.
Ops Bot: INC-462 created, assigned to @Nadia V. Please update status page and confirm anchor name.
Nadia V: I'll push the status page entry in ~10m and create `/status#incident-462-2026-03-21`. If anything blocks, authorise an emergency merge.
Taylor R: Quick ask: can @Nadia or @Jess P (docs approver) approve after the anchor is live? I don't want to land a link that 404s.
Nadia V: I'll confirm in this thread once the anchor exists. If CI still blocks after that, I'm OK with an emergency merge under `hotfix/docs` label and add a follow-up patch.
Taylor R: Updated PR to use `/status#recent-incidents` for immediate merge; added note that specific anchor will be added and PR will be backfilled if needed. Re-ran link-check locally, now green.
Infra CI: all checks passed on deploy-preview 2441.
Nadia V: Verified status page entry + anchor now live: `/status#incident-462-2026-03-21`. Confirms link is stable.
Taylor R: Thanks — requesting formal review: @Nadia V and @Jess P. Also created a backport PR for the v1 migration guide to mention the workaround: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2442.
Nadia V: Reviewing now. Note: do not include any internal runbook commands in docs public pages. Keep it curl-only and link to support for enterprise customers.
Taylor R: Understood. Kept public docs high-level.
Nadia V: Approved. @Jess P can you give docs-team approval so I can merge?
Jess P: Quick check done, wording looks fine, CI passed, anchor exists. Approved — merge when ready. :thumbsup:
Taylor R: Merged and added label `docs-hotfix`. Will post a short message in #incidents and #status-updates with links and the workaround.
Nadia V: I'll also sync with Support so they can pass the workaround to affected customers.
Taylor R: Thanks everyone. Closing loop: will follow up if any edits are needed after the postmortem is published.
